description: CyberChef: GCHQ's web app for encoding, decoding, encryption, compression and data analysis, running entirely in the browser, served by nginx with native TLS. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Atuin server: the self-hosted sync server for Atuin shell history, end-to-end encrypted, with an account generated at install and the database on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
